pageTitle: Codex 状态栏 · 双语布局演示
heading: 状态栏 · 双语布局演示
Status bar · Bilingual preview
intro: 仅切换界面语言，项目与对话名称保留 Codex 原文。这里是可离线打开的交互演示，不操作真实聊天。
Switch the interface language; project and chat names stay exactly as captured from Codex. This offline demo never operates real chats.
languageSelect: 演示 Codex 语言选择
languageRule: 简体中文 → 中文界面；其他选择 → English。项目与对话名称不翻译。
Simplified Chinese → Chinese UI. Every other choice → English UI. Project and chat names are never translated.
stageLabel: 菜单栏与弹窗的响应式预览
Responsive menu bar and popover preview
stageNote: 系统选中背景为布局示意。缩窄窗口可检查收纳，展开面板始终限制在预览安全区内。
The system selection background is illustrative. Narrow the window to test the layout; the popover stays within the preview safe area.
controlsIntro: 交互测试 · 每个项目独立从 1 连号，增删后重排。可切换状态、增加对话，或完成后逐个标记已看。
Try it: each project starts at 1 and renumbers after chats are added or removed. Change states, add chats, or mark finished chats seen.
specSummary: 布局约束与唯一尺寸表
specIntro: 只调整文件顶部的 layout-contract。构建脚本从这份定义生成正式插件的原生网格；预览不再另存一套位置。菜单栏、选中背景、胶囊、图标和编号都由 Grid 居中。系统字体与 WebKit Text Box 处理文字；同一角色共用基线，不按字符串单独补偏移。

Edit layout-contract at the top of this file. The build generates the production native grids from the same definition. Grid centers the menu bar, selection background, capsules, icons and numbers. System fonts and WebKit Text Box handle text; each role shares one baseline, without per-string offsets.
specBar: 菜单栏 / 系统选中背景
specBarRule: 背景与黑胶囊的中线完全相同
Selection and capsule share a centerline
specPillRule: 每层上下各留 2 px，内容决定宽度
2 px top and bottom per layer; content sets width
specType: 菜单图标 / 名称 / 数字
specTypeRule: 图标与文字按各自网格和字体度量定位
Icons use grid alignment; text uses font metrics
specPanelRule: 窄屏自动缩小，不超出预览边界
Shrinks on narrow screens; stays in the safe area
specRow: 聊天行 / 状态圆 / 操作位
specRowRule: 双行文字整体与状态圆、勾号居中
Two-line copy, badge and checkmark share a centerline
specScope: 项目与对话名称保留 Codex 原文。暂停项目可从右侧全局入口恢复，总开关保留各项目偏好与本地记录；示例不操作真实聊天。

Project and chat names keep their original Codex text. Resume paused projects from the right-hand control. The main switch keeps project preferences and local records. This demo never operates real chats.
textFallback: 。不支持 Text Box 时保留标准行高和 Grid 布局，不退回手算字形坐标。
. Without Text Box support, standard line height and Grid remain in use; there is no manual glyph positioning.
reloadTitle: 重新加载布局，保留当前编号与状态
Reload layout; keep current numbers and states
viewport: 预览 {width} px · 窗口 {w} × {h} · DPR {dpr}
initialLog: 点击项目名展开面板；点击编号或聊天行会触发示例“打开聊天”事件，不导航真实聊天。
Click a project name to toggle its popover. A number or chat row emits a demo “open chat” event without navigating to a real chat.
openedLog: 示例事件：打开 {project} · 聊天 {n}「{title}」 · {source}
seenLog: 已标记对话 {n} 已看；本项目显示序号已重新连号。
Chat {n} marked seen; this project’s display numbers are now consecutive.
reloadLog: 已重新加载示例布局，所有编号与状态保持。
Demo layout reloaded; all numbers and states are unchanged.
monitorOnLog: 状态更新已恢复，项目偏好与本地记录保持。
Updates resumed. Project preferences and local records are retained.
monitorOffLog: 全部更新已暂停，可从右侧入口恢复。
All updates paused. Resume from the right-hand control.
completeLog: 本项目全部完成；绿色提醒保留到标记已看。
All chats in this project are complete. Green reminders stay until marked seen.
clearLog: 已移除本项目的终态提醒；运行中的聊天不受影响。
Finished reminders removed from this project; running chats are unchanged.
fourLog: 同一项目四个对话；每个编号保持独立点击目标。
Four chats in one project; each number has its own click target.
connectedLog: 连接已恢复，保留原状态。
disconnectedLog: 连接中断，显示虚线未知态，不伪报完成。
Disconnected. Dashed badges show Unknown, not Completed.

Status changes show a brief notice at the upper right for 6 seconds. New changes update the same notice.
noticeDemoTitle: 六秒状态提示样式检查
openNotice: 打开对应的 Codex 对话

emojiDemoHint: 正式插件点击图标会打开 macOS“表情与符号”。HTML仅演示按钮外观。
The native icon button opens macOS Emoji & Symbols. This HTML previews its appearance.

Top bar disconnected; enable the Codex Signal GNOME extension
